001package com.streamconverter.logging;
002
003import java.util.ArrayDeque;
004import java.util.Deque;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.Map;
007import org.slf4j.spi.MDCAdapter;
008
009/**
010 * MDCAdapter implementation that propagates MDC context to child threads via
011 * InheritableThreadLocal.
012 *
013 * <p>The standard {@link ch.qos.logback.classic.util.LogbackMDCAdapter} uses plain {@link
014 * ThreadLocal}, which does not propagate to child threads. This implementation uses {@link
015 * InheritableThreadLocal} so that virtual threads (and platform threads) spawned from a parent
016 * automatically inherit a copy of the parent's MDC context map.
017 *
018 * <p>Use {@link MDCInitializer#initialize()} at application startup (before the first log call) to
019 * install this adapter.
020 */
021public class InheritableMDCAdapter implements MDCAdapter {
022
023  /** Constructs a new InheritableMDCAdapter. */
024  public InheritableMDCAdapter() {}
025
026  private final InheritableThreadLocal<Map<String, String>> tlm =
027      new InheritableThreadLocal<>() {
028        @Override
029        protected Map<String, String> childValue(Map<String, String> parentValue) {
030          return parentValue == null ? null : new HashMap<>(parentValue);
031        }
032      };
033
034  private final InheritableThreadLocal<Map<String, Deque<String>>> tlmDeque =
035      new InheritableThreadLocal<>() {
036        @Override
037        protected Map<String, Deque<String>> childValue(Map<String, Deque<String>> parentValue) {
038          if (parentValue == null) return null;
039          Map<String, Deque<String>> copy = new HashMap<>();
040          for (Map.Entry<String, Deque<String>> entry : parentValue.entrySet()) {
041            copy.put(entry.getKey(), new ArrayDeque<>(entry.getValue()));
042          }
043          return copy;
044        }
045      };
046
047  @Override
048  public void put(String key, String val) {
049    if (key == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("key cannot be null");
050    Map<String, String> map = tlm.get();
051    if (map == null) {
052      map = new HashMap<>();
053      tlm.set(map);
054    }
055    map.put(key, val);
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  public String get(String key) {
060    Map<String, String> map = tlm.get();
061    return (map != null && key != null) ? map.get(key) : null;
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  public void remove(String key) {
066    Map<String, String> map = tlm.get();
067    if (map != null) {
068      map.remove(key);
069      if (map.isEmpty()) {
070        tlm.remove();
071      }
072    }
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public void clear() {
077    tlm.remove();
078    tlmDeque.remove();
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  public Map<String, String> getCopyOfContextMap() {
083    Map<String, String> map = tlm.get();
084    return (map != null) ? new HashMap<>(map) : null;
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public void setContextMap(Map<String, String> contextMap) {
089    if (contextMap == null) {
090      tlm.remove();
091    } else {
092      tlm.set(new HashMap<>(contextMap));
093    }
094  }
095
096  @Override
097  public void pushByKey(String key, String value) {
098    if (key == null) return;
099    Map<String, Deque<String>> map = tlmDeque.get();
100    if (map == null) {
101      map = new HashMap<>();
102      tlmDeque.set(map);
103    }
104    map.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayDeque<>()).push(value);
105  }
106
107  @Override
108  public String popByKey(String key) {
109    if (key == null) return null;
110    Map<String, Deque<String>> map = tlmDeque.get();
111    if (map == null) return null;
112    Deque<String> deque = map.get(key);
113    return (deque != null) ? deque.pop() : null;
114  }
115
116  @Override
117  public Deque<String> getCopyOfDequeByKey(String key) {
118    Map<String, Deque<String>> map = tlmDeque.get();
119    if (map == null) return null;
120    Deque<String> deque = map.get(key);
121    return (deque != null) ? new ArrayDeque<>(deque) : null;
122  }
123
124  @Override
125  public void clearDequeByKey(String key) {
126    if (key == null) return;
127    Map<String, Deque<String>> map = tlmDeque.get();
128    if (map == null) return;
129    Deque<String> deque = map.get(key);
130    if (deque != null) {
131      deque.clear();
132    }
133  }
134}
